verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduling is a fair question for a document-processing platform, but the evidence pack shows no native scheduler, cron, or recurring workflow feature. The documented items are one-off parse jobs, batch processing, job-completion webhooks, chaining APIs, and an n8n node; these are adjacent features or external orchestration, not a product-provided recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
